mapper.sql: SELECT c.id AS id, 'CHAT' AS kind, c.question AS question, IFNULL(u.real_name, '已注销') AS person, NULL AS stallName, CASE WHEN c.hit = 0 THEN 'MISS' WHEN c.helpful = 0 THEN 'UNHELPFUL' ELSE 'ANSWERED' END AS status, c.hit AS hit, c.helpful AS helpful, c.cost_ms AS costMs, c.intent_label AS intentLabel, NULL AS merchantUnread, NULL AS orderId, c.create_time AS createTime FROM chat_log c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT s.id AS id, 'SESSION' AS kind, s.last_message AS question, IFNULL(u.real_name, '已注销') AS person, st.name AS stallName, s.status AS status, NULL AS hit, NULL AS helpful, NULL AS costMs, NULL AS intentLabel, s.merchant_unread AS merchantUnread, s.order_id AS orderId, COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.update_time, s.create_time) AS createTime FROM customer_service_session s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN canteen_stall st ON st.id = s.stall_id AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
